data.title: 中野四叶 · 长椅月光下的解开心结
data.description: 夜色渐浓的公寓天台长椅上，微凉的晚风吹拂着两人的肩头。四叶罕见地取下了标志性的绿色兔耳发带，柔顺的橙色短发安静地垂落耳畔。她微微低下头，双手紧紧交叠在膝间，眼中泛着晶莹的泪光，第一次将六年前京都的秘密与自卑全盘托出。
data.action: sitting with hands clasped, teary eyes, looking down, vulnerable look
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight and ambient shadows
data.promptProse: Sitting on a quiet outdoor rooftop bench under silver moonlight, Nakano Yotsuba appears without her ribbon, her soft orange hair loose around her cheeks. With tears glistening in her earnest blue eyes, she looks up with touching vulnerability.
data.animaCaption: Yotsuba sharing her deepest secret under the soft silver moonlight.
